ordinary_row_storage.scope: Allocated large ordinary contact-row arrays only. Prior per-group and per-world arrays are separate (_jy_world_aliased=false). Excludes factors, native MF rows, velocity/mask buffers, row metadata, tiny dummy views and every other allocation. Not total process/peak VRAM or memory traffic.
ordinary_row_storage.free_response_shape_note: The recorded one-world constructor probe confirms [1,192,6]; full-size allocation computed with the checked 16384-world count and final source allocation expressions.

kernel_activity_diagnosis.scope: Summed GPU kernel activity per environment step; kernels can overlap. Not additive critical-path timing and not substituted for the 40-step graph qualification.

stages.stage: Ordinary row producer, response and clear

stages.note: Prior output work is inside other kernels, not zero

kernel_activity_diagnosis.conclusion: Much of the large PGS saving is consumed by a slower sparse contact producer that recomputes joint-contact Jacobians across factor entries. Producer local memory is zero; this profile does not establish a spill bottleneck.

validation.test_evidence: Reported by the executing test agent from tool output on clean final147; no separate retained log file
coverage: Independent physical-coordinate dense oracle for sparse factors, mixed factor/physical contact rows and PGS sweeps
Robot/object, object/object, static and self contact; endpoint and articulation ordering
Nonzero COM and rotated anisotropic inertia; multiple same-topology robots per world
Prescribed moving support; separate robot-only and free-only worlds
CUDA graph replay, partial reset, mass notification
Native MF type-4 stateless velocity limits and zero-MF-capacity ordinary free responses
validation.artifact_verification_evidence: Executing benchmark agent re-read and verified all 80 stored capture/check/analysis/log hashes after completion.

limitations: Current implementation supports one shared responding articulated topology/size, plus independent free6 bodies and prescribed endpoints; multiple same-topology articulations may share a world.

The 64-bit ancestry representation and single-topology group are unfinished representation work, not physical limitations. Unsupported native solver features retain the existing path rather than being disabled.
Accepted finite-state/constraint/sticky-row/full-log checks and collision boundary snapshots do not establish lifetime no-drop, numerical convergence over all workloads, or training equivalence.
Seed equality does not imply identical trajectories after floating-point reordering.
Full raw captures remain local; artifact locators are relative to the local sparse-results directory, not bundled downloadable files.
bundle_adapter_changes: Portable benchmark adds --gpu-index, default0 and nonnegative, with mandatory matching GPU UUID; no physics loop or retained-helper changes
Both device selections passed CPU-only full20 --plan-only against clean147; no new GPU capture was run with this portable adapter
